title: Move to Other clears Gmail's mark with one Cmd-Z (fake data)
steps: On the fake data, in the Important tab run Move to Other from ⌘K on a conversation, then press Cmd-Z
Run Not important (⌘K) on another conversation in the Important tab
Turn off Settings › Importance & labels › Rules › Tell Gmail when I move mail and run Move to Other again
expected: Step 1: the row leaves Important at once, the toast says Moved to Other, and one Cmd-Z brings back the row and its Important mark. Step 2: the same as step 1, plus an offer of Never important for this sender or domain that saves nothing until clicked. Step 3: the toast says Moved to Other on this Mac (the fake inbox follows only Gmail's mark, so the row may stay).
